subject: Qualification recap: deployment options & SLA priorities
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@medsim.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification recap: deployment options & SLA priorities

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can line up the right folks from our side and keep momentum: 

Recap (from our side)
- Goals: reduce inference latency for near-real-time clinical decisioning, keep unit cost predictable for the model-hosted parts of your pipeline.
- Key constraints you mentioned: low 95th-pct latency target, procurement needs SOC 2 evidence, and an approval path that includes engineering leadership + procurement.

Clarifying questions / asks
1) Economic buyer: can you confirm the primary decision maker for budget? You mentioned Marcus Lee — is Marcus the approver for this purchase? Please include his preferred email if different.
2) Security / procurement owners: you said legal/security will run an intake. Who should we expect to see on the security questionnaire (Raj? Priya in procurement?) and what is the target review cadence (2 weeks / 4 weeks)?
3) Decision criteria: can you confirm the latency target (95th percentile) and a rough cost sensitivity level? For our planning it helps to know a numeric latency target and whether cost is a hard cap or a tiebreaker.

Where we can help next
- Attached is a first-pass SLA we can iterate on. [Attachment: SLA-draft-MedSim-2026.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
- Ben (cc'd) can run a short benchmark on a Dedicated configuration that mirrors your traffic profile — we can have sample numbers on the next call.
- If helpful, we can share a short reference checklist (SOC 2 artifacts, pen-test summary) for your security team.

Suggested next steps
- Can we schedule a 30-min procurement + security sync next week with the people who will run the review?
- Please confirm Marcus and Priya (procurement) so we can add them to the invite.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the confirmations and will send two time options for a joint call.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Claire Thompson <claire@medsim.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Procurement <priya.proc@medsim.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: deployment options & SLA priorities

Jasmine — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

1) Economic buyer: Marcus Lee (VP Engineering) will sign off on budget. He’s cc’d on the thread once we loop him in; his email is marcus.lee@medsim.com. He will want a concise TCO estimate and a simple ROI narrative tied to throughput gains.

2) Security & procurement: Raj Patel (cloud security) will own the technical security review; Priya in procurement (cc) will run the contracting path. Timeline: procurement target is ~4 weeks from initial intake, security review ~2 weeks but they often run in parallel.

3) Decision criteria / targets: our product team would like a 95th percentile latency target of 85–100ms for typical 2k token prompts. Cost sensitivity is medium — we are willing to pay a premium for predictable latency but need clear unit economics for scale. SOC 2 and a recent pen-test report are must-haves.

4) Deployment preference: our infra team prefers either Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or a Private VPC deployment; Hosted (multi-tenant) is a lower preference due to data residency concerns.

Attachments: I’ve attached the initial security intake worksheet that Raj will use. [Attachment: MedSim-security-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 78KB)]

Please loop in Marcus and Raj on the next call — both want to see the proposed SLA language and the benchmark numbers before committing. Priya will coordinate timing for procurement.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Thompson
Head of Product, MedSim
claire@medsim.com | +1 (650) 555-0127

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@medsim.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: deployment options & SLA priorities

Claire — great, really helpful. Quick follow-up and proposed plan:

Summary of what we heard
- Econ buyer: Marcus Lee (VP Eng) — will want TCO and ROI.
- Security: Raj Patel will run the technical intake; Priya will handle contracting/procurement.
- Targets: 95th-pct latency target ~85–100ms for 2k token prompts; cost sensitivity medium.
- Deployment preference: Dedicated or Private VPC.

What Redwood can commit to for planning
- Dedicated configuration: we can target ≤100ms 95th on a Dedicated pool with the recommended model and tuning; many customers in this tier see 80–95ms depending on prompt shape. We’ll provide a short benchmark tailored to your sample prompt set.
- SLA: we can offer a 99.9% availability SLA with standard downtime credits; the attached SLA draft reflects that (see section 3). Updated SLA attached — we’ll iterate based on legal feedback. [Attachment: SLA-draft-MedSim-2026.pdf v1.1]
- Security artifacts: we’ll provide SOC 2 report excerpt and pen-test summary for the security team to review.

Next steps (proposed)
1) Jasmine + Ben + Raj (security) + Marcus (econ buyer) — 30-minute sync to review the SLA and the benchmark plan. Please propose two 30-min windows; I’ll coordinate.
2) Ben will prepare a targeted benchmark run (Dedicated config) using a 2k-token sample set and share the results within 48 hours of our sync.
3) We’ll open a HubSpot deal and share the TCO workbook — link below.

Availability: I can do Wed 8/18 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 8/19 13:00–14:00 PT. Which works best for Marcus and Raj?

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7634123 (RDW-5312)

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@medsim.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: deployment options & SLA priorities

Claire / team — adding a quick technical note from our side.

> From: Jasmine Liu
> Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Qualification recap: deployment options & SLA priorities
> 
> Dedicated configuration: we can target ≤100ms 95th on a Dedicated pool with the recommended model and tuning; many customers in this tier see 80–95ms depending on prompt shape.

I’ll prepare a short latency run that mirrors a 2k-token prompt mix and share the runbook + raw numbers. Concretely:
- Deliverable: 1-page benchmark summary (95th, p50, p99) + runbook (config, model variant, batch settings).
- Expected turnaround: I can have the numbers within 48 hours of the sync Jasmine sets up.
- Dependencies: sample prompt set (can use the 10 sample prompts you mentioned on the call) and an agreed concurrency profile (we typically test at 10 qps and 20 qps for sizing).

I’ll also include a short note on deployment trade-offs (Dedicated vs Private VPC) so Marcus and Raj can see the ops differences in a single slide.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
